messages:
alex.sales: Hey team — quick heads up. POC with Mercury Health finished today. They liked the Dedicated + VPC setup. Ask: Net-90 payment terms with annual contract but invoices split quarterly (4 invoices). Also asking for a 35% discount off our list for a 12-month $480k commit. Need deal desk + finance signoff. Security questionnaire is done and green. TL;DR: non-standard payment schedule + large discount.
mira.solutions: Nice. How time-sensitive is this?
alex.sales: They want a signed contract by 2025-03-28 or they’ll go to the other vendor. They said cashflow constrained, so prefer split: 25% on sign, then 25% every 90 days. They also require PO# on invoices.
jon.deals: 35% feels high for this band. Our standard at that commit level and dedicated is typically 18–22% if paid upfront annually. Do we know expected retention/upsell? Are they committing to committed MRR or usage caps?
alex.sales: They're estimating ~1.2M tokens/day steady-state. Committed $480k ARR equivalent. They want Dedicated with SLA and white-glove onboarding. Upsell potential is real — clinical models + additional deployment regions.
raj.finance: Finance notes: Net-90 is a material credit risk. If we consider Net-90 + split invoices, require completed credit application, trade refs, and approval from the credit committee. Also we'll want 25% non-refundable at signing. If we accept extended terms, add late-interest (1.5% monthly) and collection fees in the contract. PO on invoices is OK but doesn't change due-dates.
emily.legal: Legal: we'll need a Payment Annex + invoice schedule in the contract. For PO requirement, add language: we will reference customer PO numbers on invoices but invoices are payable per schedule irrespective of PO processing times. Need provisioning trigger clause tied to receipt of first invoice payment. No special liability changes for payment terms.
jon.deals: Counterproposal I can push: 25% discount + $50k onboarding fee with annual upfront single invoice, or 30% discount if they pay single upfront. If they insist on Net-90 + quartered invoices, we drop to 18% discount and require 25% up front and credit approval.
alex.sales: Customer pushed back — competitor offered 30% if they sign now. They prefer the split for cashflow reasons but said they could do single invoice if we can offer 30%. If we push single invoice, risk losing deal. Any precedent approving Net-90 + quad invoices?
raj.finance: Precedent is rare. We have done multi-invoice schedules for large enterprise but always with >=25% at signing, credit checks, and trade references. Approve in principle only if credit check passes and legal puts in provisioning hold language. Otherwise finance will not sign off.
mira.solutions: Operational flag: provisioning Dedicated hardware takes ~4 weeks after first cleared payment. If payments are delayed, we will hold provisioning until the minimum payment clears. Need explicit clause to avoid partial provisioning.
emily.legal: I'll draft the Payment Annex, invoice schedule, and provisioning trigger language. I’ll add the PO clause that invoices are due per schedule regardless of PO timing. Tagging @jon.deals for pricing final. Legal ETA 24–48hrs.
jon.deals: I'll run the pricing options with the deal desk. My suggested terms to present to customer: Option A — single upfront annual invoice: 30% discount; Option B — split quarterly invoices with 25% at signing + credit approval: 20% discount + $40k onboarding fee. If finance requires higher upfront, we keep discount at 25% and waive onboarding fee.
alex.sales: I’ll present A and B. To buy time I proposed an LOI that captures basic economics and an invoice schedule. Sending LOI now. LOI snippet below: 
```
LOI (summary): Mercury Health agrees to 12-mo committment $480k. Option A: single upfront, invoice on signing, 30% off list. Option B: split invoices (25% on signing, then 25% @90/180/270 days), requires credit approval and 25% non-refundable at signing, 20% off list + onboarding fee $40k. Provisioning begins after clearing of first invoice. PO numbers accepted for invoice reference only.
```
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Created credit-check request #CC-4721 and assigned to raj.finance.
raj.finance: Acknowledged. I'll run CC + trade refs, aim to respond with decision or required mitigants within 48 hours.
